name: Vampire on Trial
source:
A Vampire preying on innocents is finally apprehended. 

Will he be found Guilty? 

What does Justice stand for?

What will your verdict be?

[From [url=https://afancyquestionmark.itch.io/vampire-on-trial]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一名猎杀无辜民众的吸血鬼终于落网受审。

他会被判处有罪吗？

正义究竟代表着什么？

你将做出怎样的裁决？

[摘自[url=https://afancyquestionmark.itch.io/vampire-on-trial]itch.io[/url]]
